scope: LAMBS casualty equipment recovery and actual CBE path; no parity claimed
sourceExecution: brainHide dispatches doCheckBody for DANGER_DEADBODYGROUP after PATH gate.
tacticsReinforce checks any dead man within35m, then queues body checks per unit with random2s delay, random20m search origin/radius35, and adds wait time.
doCheckBody selects first allDeadMen entry within radius, sets weak crouch, movement/watch/forceMove, waits <=8s for range<0.8m or actor death.
On arrival requests native rearm action; if actor has no backpack, reads backpackItems and class, removes source backpack globally, recreates on actor and adds items.
If actor has no launcher, nearSupplies3 cargo arrays are inspected for type4 weapon, then TakeWeapon requested.
Arrival and timeout use unconditional doFollow leader and clear forceMove; no exact newer-order receipt.
currentCBE: DangerEngineAct starts PointActorOperation from observed casualty clue; current actor-local token, native order receipt, original deadline and physical range/LOS gate qualify VISITED.
VISITED intentionally proves only position observation. No native rearm action, backpack transfer or launcher acquisition occurs.
CortexAmmoShare transfers bounded compatible primary reserves between current squad members; it does not recover equipment from bodies.
disposition: IMPLEMENT source intent: finite opportunistic recovery of useful ammunition/equipment after actual approach, subordinate to tactical urgency, mission orders and specialist ownership.
REDESIGN selection: use observed/reachable specific body and bounded local supplies, not global first-match allDeadMen scan or arbitrary remote inventory enumeration.

REDESIGN execution: separate observation success from actual equipment result; actor-local native action with original finite timeout, explicit inventory delta evidence and current token/native-order checks before issue and cleanup.

DO NOT COPY destructive backpack recreation: items alone omit nested magazine ammunition, attachments and inventory-state fidelity; preserve mission loadout restrictions and source-container ownership.
DO NOT COPY first weapon-cargo slot classifier as universal launcher selection; empty/mixed cargo and compatibility must be checked.
DO NOT COPY unconditional formation recall over newer orders. No teleport, global invulnerability, forced arsenal loadout or synthetic recovered result.

nextImplementation.priority: First implement ammunition-only native recovery through a separately identified finite actor phase after physically approaching a qualified observed body; retain observation-only mode. Equipment/launcher adoption remains separately scoped.
requiredBeforeCode: Verify native Rearm action and cancellation semantics against official engine documentation.
Trace body/local inventory ownership and native action acknowledgement without stealing mission-authored REARM.
Use existing actor task reservation and cleanup receipt, not a second movement controller.
Record actual acquired compatible rounds independently of visit success; failure must release exact current task without erasing replacement orders.
nextImplementation.limits: Original deadline, bounded candidate count and existing actor scheduler. No permanent all-body scans or inventory cloning.
